about.headline: A characterful home in the heart of Lake Como
about.p1: A small retreat in the mountains, just a few steps from the wonders of Lake Como.
about.p2: In the historic heart of **Naggio**, a picturesque hamlet of Grandola ed Uniti, time seems to pass more slowly. Among ancient stone houses, the quiet of the mountains and enchanting views over the waters of **Lake Como and Lake Lugano**, every moment invites you to pause, breathe and be captivated by the beauty of the landscape.
about.p3: **4 Guests · 1 Bed + 1 Double Sofa Bed · Private Garden · Pets Allowed · Non-Smoking**
amenities.body: **Crooked House** has everything you need to make your stay pleasant, comfortable and worry-free.

explore.body: **Crooked House** is an ideal base for discovering Lake Como and its mountains, offering a blend of **relaxation, nature, sport and culture.** Its location makes it easy to reach picturesque destinations such as **Menaggio, Tremezzina, Varenna and Bellagio,** as well as numerous hiking trails, walking routes and e-bike routes. You can also extend your trip to **Lugano,** in Switzerland.
explore.headline: Explore the area
footer.description: A distinctive one-bedroom apartment in Grandola ed Uniti, above Menaggio on Lake Como.
gallery.body: **Crooked House** is a one-bedroom apartment, carefully restored and furnished to offer a stay defined by comfort, beauty and simplicity. You’ll have all the space and privacy you need: **a private entrance, a cosy living room, a fully equipped kitchen and a private garden** nestled in tranquillity and framed by the mountains.

The tourist tax is a municipal contribution applied to guests staying in accommodation facilities in the Municipality of Grandola ed Uniti (CO). The amount is calculated per person per night, according to the type of facility and the rates established by the Municipality.

servicesPage.sectionBodies:
To make your stay even more pleasant, we offer breakfast and dinner service upon request, designed to make you feel at home.

You can start the day with a delicious breakfast and end it with a carefully prepared dinner, in a warm, welcoming, and cozy atmosphere.

For those who love to explore the area, a packed lunch service is also available upon request, ideal to take with you during trips and excursions.

Service costs and booking methods are available directly at the property.

Information on food intolerances

The facility does not have suitable environments and equipment to guarantee the absence of cross-contamination. Therefore, we cannot ensure the preparation of specific meals for people with gluten or lactose intolerances.

Our facility is committed to ensuring high standards of quality, safety, and professionalism, in compliance with current regulations and through constant skill updates.

The training and qualifications obtained testify to our attention to detail, the correct management of services, and the quality of the experience offered to our guests.

PRIVACY POLICY
Processing of users' and guests' personal data

In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and applicable Italian law, this privacy policy describes the methods of processing the personal data of users visiting the website and guests who book or stay at our holiday home.

1. Data Controller
The data controller is:

[First and last name of the owner / Company name]
Name of the facility: [Name of the holiday home]
Address: [Full address of the facility]
Tax Code / VAT Number: [Insert applicable data]
E-mail: [Contact e-mail address]
Telephone: [Phone number]

For any information relating to the processing of personal data or to exercise the rights provided by law, you may contact the controller using the contact details indicated above.

2. Types of personal data processed
In the context of website navigation, booking management, and the provision of accommodation services, the following categories of data may be processed:

Identification data: name, surname, nationality, and other data necessary to identify guests.
Identity document data: exclusively those necessary for legal compliance related to hospitality.
Contact data: e-mail address and telephone number.
Booking data: dates of stay, number of guests, requests received, confirmations, modifications, and cancellations.
Administrative and payment data: information necessary for managing fees, payments, and tax and accounting obligations.
Data contained in communications: information voluntarily transmitted by users via e-mail, telephone, or contact forms that may be present on the website.
Technical navigation data: information generated by IT systems and communication protocols during site browsing, such as IP address, date and time of access, information on the browser and requests made, within the limits in which they are actually collected.
The facility does not request personal data not relevant to the purposes of the processing. Users are advised not to transmit sensitive or special information unless strictly necessary and an adequate legal basis exists.

3. Purposes and legal bases of the processing
Personal data are processed for the following purposes:

a) Management of information requests and bookings

To respond to user requests, verify availability, make proposals, confirm bookings, and manage any changes or cancellations.

Legal basis: performance of pre-contractual measures requested by the data subject and performance of the contract, pursuant to Article 6, paragraph 1, letter b), of the GDPR.

b) Management of the stay and related services

To organize the welcome, communicate information necessary for the stay, and manage services requested by guests.

Legal basis: performance of the contract and, where applicable, compliance with legal obligations.

c) Administrative and regulatory compliance

To comply with the obligations provided by the legislation applicable to accommodation facilities, including obligations relating to the communication of guests' personal details to the competent authorities, as well as tax and accounting obligations.

Legal basis: compliance with legal obligations pursuant to Article 6, paragraph 1, letter c), of the GDPR.

d) Payment management and protection of rights

To verify payments, manage any disputes, and protect the facility's rights in extrajudicial or judicial proceedings, when necessary.

Legal basis: performance of the contract, compliance with legal obligations, or the legitimate interest of the controller, depending on the specific case.

e) Security and functioning of the website

To ensure the correct functioning of the site, prevent unauthorized access, and manage any technical problems.

Legal basis: legitimate interest of the controller, where applicable, respecting the rights and freedoms of the data subjects.

No promotional communications or profiling activities are carried out based on the information currently available. Should such activities be introduced, the privacy policy will be updated and any consent required by law will be requested.

4. Bookings via the website and external platforms
Bookings can be made directly through the facility's channels or through online mediation and booking platforms.

In the case of direct booking, personal data are processed by the controller to manage the request, conclude the contract, and organize the stay.

In the case of booking through external platforms, data may also be collected and processed by the platform concerned, according to its own contractual terms and privacy policies.

The platform and the facility may act as independent data controllers for their respective purposes. Information regarding the processing carried out by the platform is available in the relevant privacy policy.

5. Nature of data provision
Providing the data necessary for booking management, the provision of the stay, and compliance with legal obligations is necessary for the respective purposes.

Failure to provide indispensable data may result in the impossibility of confirming the booking, providing the requested service, or complying with regulatory obligations.

Providing additional and non-necessary information is optional.

6. Processing methods and security
Personal data are processed using IT tools and, where necessary, paper documentation, according to procedures appropriate to the purposes pursued.

The controller adopts technical and organizational measures proportionate to the risk to protect personal data from loss, destruction, unauthorized access, disclosure, or unlawful use.

Data are accessible exclusively to the controller and any authorized or appointed persons, within the limits of their respective competencies.

7. Communication of data
Personal data may be communicated, within the limits of the indicated purposes, to:

public authorities and competent bodies, in cases provided by law;
tax consultants, accountants, and appointed professionals;
banking institutions and payment service providers;
hosting, maintenance, and IT assistance providers;
booking platforms and intermediaries used by the guest;
other providers involved in managing the stay, when necessary.
The recipients act, depending on the case, as independent controllers or data processors.

Data are not indiscriminately disseminated to the public.

8. Transfer of data outside the European Economic Area
Should a transfer of personal data to countries outside the European Economic Area occur through external platforms or service providers, the transfer will take place in compliance with the conditions and guarantees provided by the GDPR.

Information regarding any transfers actually carried out may be requested from the controller.

9. Retention period
Personal data are kept for the time necessary to achieve the purposes for which they were collected and, subsequently, for the periods provided for by applicable law or necessary to protect the rights of the controller.

In particular:

data relating to requests and bookings are kept for the time necessary to manage the relationship and any subsequent obligations;
administrative, tax, and accounting data are kept for the terms provided by applicable law;
data relating to public safety obligations are kept and managed according to the specific applicable provisions;
technical navigation data are kept for the period necessary for the purposes of security and the functioning of the site, according to the policies actually adopted by the service provider.
Specific retention periods are defined based on the category of data, legal obligations, and the characteristics of the systems used.

10. Cookies and navigation data
According to the information currently available, the site does not use additional statistical analysis, advertising profiling, or marketing tools.

However, navigation may involve the processing of technical data by the server hosting the site or the use of technical cookies necessary for its operation.

The actual technologies used, including those potentially integrated into the booking system, must be verified before the final publication of this privacy policy.

If the site uses only technical cookies, the relevant information may be included in this privacy policy. If tracking tools that require prior consent are used, the information and consent management methods provided by applicable law will be adopted.

11. Rights of the data subjects
Data subjects may exercise, in the cases and within the limits provided by the GDPR, the following rights:

to obtain confirmation of the existence of processing and access to their personal data;
to request the rectification of inaccurate data or the completion of incomplete data;
to request the erasure of data, when the requirements are met;
to request the restriction of processing;
to object to processing based on legitimate interest, for reasons connected to their particular situation;
to obtain data portability, in cases provided by law;
to withdraw consent, if provided, without affecting the lawfulness of the processing prior to the withdrawal;
to lodge a complaint with the Data Protection Authority.
Requests can be sent to the controller's contact details indicated in this privacy policy.

12. Changes to the privacy policy
This privacy policy may be updated in the event of regulatory, organizational, or technical changes affecting the processing of personal data.

The updated version will be published on the facility's website.

Last updated: 24/10/2026.

For further information on the processing of personal data, you may contact the controller at the contact details indicated in this privacy policy.
termsPage.title: Terms and conditions
termsPage.sectionTitles: General terms and conditions of stay
termsPage.sectionBodies:
You may cancel the reservation up to 10 days before the scheduled check-in date to receive a full refund of the amount paid.

In the event of a cancellation made after this deadline, no refund will be provided.

1. Introduction
These general conditions govern the procedures for booking, access, stay, and use of the services offered by the accommodation facility.
Confirmation of the reservation implies that you have read and accepted the conditions set forth in this document, without prejudice to the mandatory provisions provided by current legislation.
2. Reservations
Reservations can be made through the facility's official contact channels or via authorized platforms.
The reservation is considered confirmed according to the methods communicated at the time of the request and, where applicable, following the payment of the required amount.
Any special requests must be communicated in advance and will only be considered confirmed upon acceptance by the facility.
3. Check-in and check-out
Check-in and check-out times are communicated at the time of booking or prior to arrival.
Guests are required to respect the agreed times, unless otherwise agreed upon and previously authorized by the facility.
Any requests for early arrival or late departure will be assessed based on availability and may incur additional costs if communicated and agreed upon in advance.
4. Payments
Rates, payment methods, and any amounts to be paid in advance are communicated at the time of booking.
Guests are required to respect the agreed payment deadlines. Any additional services requested during the stay will be charged according to the rates communicated by the facility.
Any tourist tax, where applicable, will be charged in accordance with the regulations in force in the relevant Municipality.
5. Cancellations and refunds
The reservation can be cancelled up to 10 days before the scheduled check-in date, with the right to a full refund of the amount paid.
In the event of a cancellation made within 9 days of check-in, or in the event of a no-show, no refund will be provided.
The cancellation request must be communicated through the channel used for the reservation or via the facility's official contact details. The date the communication is received will be taken as the reference.
For reservations made through external platforms, the specific conditions provided by the platform may also apply, within the limits of their compatibility with the confirmed conditions and current legislation.
6. Breakfast, meals, and additional services
Breakfast, dinner, and packed lunch services are available upon request, subject to availability and according to the rates communicated directly by the facility.
Any special dietary requests must be reported in advance. The facility does not have suitable environments and equipment to guarantee the absence of cross-contamination and, therefore, cannot ensure the preparation of safe meals for people who require a gluten-free or lactose-free diet for medical reasons.
Additional services are subject to availability and must be agreed upon in advance.
7. Rules of conduct
Guests are invited to maintain respectful behavior towards other guests, staff, environments, and the surrounding context.
Care must be taken when using the furniture, equipment, and spaces provided, avoiding behaviors that may cause disturbance or compromise the safety and tranquility of the facility.
Any damage caused intentionally or through negligence may be charged to the person responsible, following verification and in compliance with current legislation.
8. Cleaning and care of the premises
The facility guarantees the cleanliness of the premises and the maintenance of the spaces according to the procedures provided for the service offered.
Guests are required to use the premises with care and to promptly report any anomalies, malfunctions, or needs encountered during the stay.
9. Safety and liability
Guests are required to follow safety indications and any instructions provided by the facility.
The facility adopts measures within its competence to ensure a safe and comfortable stay. Liability for any damage, loss, or inconvenience will be assessed according to the circumstances of the case and applicable legal provisions.
Guests are invited to look after their personal belongings carefully and to promptly report any problems.
10. Compliance with regulations and personal data
The facility collects and processes guests' personal data exclusively for purposes related to reservation management, service delivery, and legal compliance, in accordance with applicable personal data protection regulations.
11. Acceptance of the conditions
Confirmation of the reservation implies that you have read these general conditions, without prejudice to the protections recognized to guests by current legislation.
For any clarification regarding reservations, available services, or conditions of stay, guests may contact the facility directly through the official contact details published on the website.
The facility reserves the right to update these conditions, provided that the changes shall not retroactively affect the rights arising from reservations already confirmed, within the limits provided by law.
